name: manual_cac9a4
claim: An idle-unload timeout only limits how long a model stays in memory; it does not stop the load or prevent memory exhaustion. Before calling a machine safe from model loads, check every automatic loader: startup and bootstrap scripts, gateway fallback chains, heartbeat models and login items.

decisions.notes: A five-minute keep-alive was set in draft branches while the main branch startup script pinned the model indefinitely and the running gateway listed the same local model as a fallback and heartbeat.

rationale: A five-minute keep-alive was set in draft branches while the main branch startup script pinned the model indefinitely and the running gateway listed the same local model as a fallback and heartbeat.
